about.bio:
I am a software developer, with a background at the crossroads of computer science, finance and Web3 technologies. Today, I work in the life insurance sector, where I contribute to business projects, web interfaces, batch processes and document systems.

But my interest does not stop at code. I like understanding systems: technical, economic, social and political. What motivates me is building useful tools, but also thinking about the role technology can play in our lives and in society.

This portfolio brings together several sides of who I am: my developer journey, my projects, my interest in Web3, but also my reflections, travels and the ideas that shape me.
